name: add_issue_comment
description:
Add a comment to an issue.

This function adds a comment to a specific issue. It takes the repository's
owner, the repository name, the issue number, and the comment's body content
as input. Upon successful execution, it provides a dictionary containing
details of the newly created comment.

owner.description: The owner of the repository.

repo.description: The name of the repository.

issue_number.description: The number that identifies the issue.

name: add_pull_request_review_comment
description: Add a review comment to a pull request or reply to an existing comment.

owner.description: The account owner of the repository. Must be a non-empty string.

repo.description: The name of the repository. Must be a non-empty string.

pull_number.description: The number identifying the pull request. Must be a positive integer.

body.description: The text of the review comment.

commit_id.description: The SHA of the commit to comment on. Must be a 40 hex character string. Required if `in_reply_to` is not provided. Default is None.

path.description: The relative path to the file that necessitates a comment. Required if `in_reply_to` is not provided and the comment is not a reply. Default is None.

line.description: The line of the blob in the pull request diff that the comment applies to. For a multi-line comment, this is the last line of the range. Required for new line-level comments (when `subject_type` is 'line' or inferred as such). Default is None.

side.description: The side of the diff to comment on. Valid values are 'LEFT' (for the old version) or 'RIGHT' (for the new version). Defaults to 'RIGHT' if `line` is provided but `side` is not. Only used for line-level comments. Default is None.

start_line.description: For a multi-line comment, the first line of the range. `line` should be the end line. Only used for line-level comments. Default is None.

start_side.description: The side of the diff for `start_line`. Valid values are 'LEFT' or 'RIGHT'. Default is the `side` parameter if not provided. Only used for multi-line comments. Default is None.

subject_type.description: The type of subject for the comment. Valid values are 'line' or 'file'. If 'file', line-specific parameters (`line`, `side`, `start_line`, `start_side`) are ignored. If 'line', they are used. If not provided, inferred based on presence of `line` parameter: 'line' if `line` is provided, 'file' otherwise. Default is None.

in_reply_to.description: The ID of an existing comment to which this comment is a reply. If provided, parameters like `commit_id`, `path`, `line`, `side`, `start_line`, `start_side`, and `subject_type` are typically ignored as the reply inherits context from the parent comment. Default is None.

name: create_issue
description:
Create a new issue in a Githut repository.

This function facilitates the creation of a new issue within a designated Githut repository.
It accepts details such as the issue's title, an optional body, optional assignees,
and optional labels to initialize the issue.

owner.description: The owner of the repository.

repo.description: The name of the repository.

title.description: The title of the issue. Cannot be empty.

assignees.description: A list of Githut logins to assign to this issue.

labels.description: A list of label names to add to this issue.

name: create_or_update_repository_file
description: Create or update a single file in a repository. This function calculates Git-compatible tree and commit SHAs following the Git specification, including automatic sorting of directory entries alphabetically by name before SHA calculation.

owner.description: The account owner of the repository (max 39 characters). Only alphanumeric characters, dots, hyphens, and underscores are allowed.

repo.description: The name of the repository (max 100 characters). Only alphanumeric characters, dots, hyphens, underscores, and forward slashes are allowed.

path.description: The path to the file in the repository (max 4096 characters). Cannot be empty or contain only slashes and whitespace.

content.description: The new file content, base64 encoded. Empty string for empty files. File is stored internally as base64 to support both text and binary files.

branch.description: The branch name (max 255 characters). Cannot start or end with a hyphen. If not provided, targets the repository's default branch. Default is None.

sha.description: The blob SHA of the file being replaced. Must be a 40-character hexadecimal string. Required when updating an existing file. Obtain the current blob SHA from get_repository_file_contents. Default is None.

author_email.description: Custom author email address for the commit. If not provided, the authenticated user's email is used.

committer_email.description: Custom committer email address for the commit. If not provided, the authenticated user's email is used.

name: create_pull_request
description: Create a new pull request. This function creates a new pull request in the specified repository. It requires the owner of the repository, the repository name, the title for the pull request, the head branch (the branch with the proposed changes), and the base branch (the branch into which the changes will be merged). Optional parameters include the body of the pull request, whether it should be a draft, and whether maintainers can modify it.

owner.description: The account owner of the repository. Must be a non-empty string. The name is not case sensitive.

repo.description: The name of the repository without the .git extension. Must be a non-empty string. The name is not case sensitive.

title.description: The title of the new pull request. Must be a non-empty string.

head.description: The name of the branch where your changes are implemented. Must be a non-empty string.

base.description: The name of the branch you want the changes pulled into. Must be a non-empty string.

body.description: The contents of the pull request. Default is None.

draft.description: Indicates whether the pull request is a draft. Default is False.

maintainer_can_modify.description: Indicates whether maintainers can modify the pull request. Default is False.

name: create_pull_request_review
description: Creates a review on a specified pull request. Implements the Githut API endpoint for creating pull request reviews. Supports different review states (APPROVE, REQUEST_CHANGES, COMMENT, PENDING), optional body text, and inline draft review comments.

owner.description: The account owner of the repository. Must be a non-empty string.

repo.description: The name of the repository. Must be a non-empty string.

pull_number.description: The number identifying the pull request. Must be a positive integer.

commit_id.description: The SHA of the commit to which the review applies. Must be a 40 hex character string. If not provided, the review applies to the latest commit on the pull request head branch.

body.description: The main body text of the pull request review. Required and must be non-empty if event is 'REQUEST_CHANGES' or 'COMMENT'.

event.description: The review action to perform. Valid values are: 'APPROVE', 'REQUEST_CHANGES', 'COMMENT'. If not provided, the review is created in 'PENDING' state.

comments.description: An array of draft review comment objects to be included with this review. Default is None.

items.description: Input structure for creating a new review comment.

path.description: Required. The relative path to the file being commented on.

body.description: Required. The text of the review comment.

position.description: The line index in the diff hunk. Must be >= 1. Default is None.

line.description: The line number in the file diff. Must be >= 1. Default is None.

side.description: The side of the diff. Default is 'RIGHT'.

start_line.description: For multi-line comments, the first line. Must be <= line and >= 1. Default is None.

start_side.description: The side of the diff for start_line. Default is None.

end_line.description: Alias for 'line' field. If provided, maps to 'line'.

name: create_repository
description: Create a new Githut repository.

name.description: The name for the new repository. Must be 1-100 characters.

description.description: An optional description for the repository (max 1000 characters). Default is None.

private.description: If True, the repository will be private. Default is False.

auto_init.description: If True, creates an initial commit, potentially with a README. Default is False.

name: create_repository_branch
description: Create a new branch. This function establishes a new branch of development within the repository.

owner.description: The account owner of the repository. Must be a non-empty string.

repo.description: The name of the repository. Must be a non-empty string.

branch.description: The name of the new branch to create. Must be a non-empty string.

sha.description: The SHA of the commit from which the new branch will be created. Must be a non-empty string.

name: fork_repository
description: Fork a repository. Creates a fork for the authenticated user.

owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive. Must be a non-empty string without whitespace characters. Maximum 39 characters.

repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive. Must be a non-empty string without whitespace characters. Maximum 100 characters.

organization.description: Optional parameter to specify the organization name if forking into an organization. Default is None. If provided, must be a non-empty string without whitespace characters. Maximum 39 characters.

name: get_authenticated_user
description: Get details of the authenticated user.

name: get_issue_comments
description:
Get comments for a Githut issue or pull request.

This function gets comments for a Githut issue or pull request. In Githut's model,
pull requests are also issues and share the same number sequence. The issue/pull
request is identified using the provided repository owner, repository name, and
issue number. For pull requests, this returns all comment types: issue comments,
review comments (code review comments), and review summary comments.

owner.description: The owner of the repository.

repo.description: The name of the repository.

issue_number.description: The number of the issue or pull request. In Githut, pull requests and issues share the same number sequence per repository.

name: get_issue_content
description:
Gets the contents of an issue within a repository.

This function retrieves detailed information about a specific issue identified
by its number, belonging to the specified repository and owner. The returned
dictionary is a direct representation of the data for the found issue.

owner.description: The owner of the repository.

repo.description: The name of the repository.

issue_number.description: The number that identifies the issue.

name: get_pull_request_details
description: Get details of a specific pull request. Uses the owner, repository name, and pull request number to retrieve comprehensive details.

owner.description: The account owner of the repository. Must be a non-empty string.

repo.description: The name of the repository. Must be a non-empty string.

pull_number.description: The number identifying the pull request. Must be a positive integer.

name: get_pull_request_files
description: Get the list of files changed in a pull request.

owner.description: The account owner of the repository. Must be a non-empty string.

repo.description: The name of the repository. Must be a non-empty string.

pull_number.description: The number identifying the pull request. Must be a positive integer.

name: get_pull_request_review_comments
description: Get the review comments on a pull request. Retrieves all review comments associated with a specific pull request.

owner.description: The account owner of the repository. Must be a non-empty string.

repo.description: The name of the repository. Must be a non-empty string.

pull_number.description: The number identifying the pull request. Must be a positive integer.

name: get_pull_request_reviews
description: Lists all reviews for a specified pull request. The list of reviews returns in chronological order.

owner.description: The account owner of the repository. Must be a non-empty string.

repo.description: The name of the repository. Must be a non-empty string.

pull_number.description: The number identifying the pull request. Must be a positive integer.

name: get_pull_request_status
description: Get the combined status of all status checks for a pull request.

owner.description: The account owner of the repository. Must be a non-empty string.

repo.description: The name of the repository. Must be a non-empty string.

pull_number.description: The number identifying the pull request. Must be a positive integer.

name: get_repository_commit_details
description: Get details for a commit from a repository.

owner.description: The owner of the repository.

repo.description: The name of the repository.

sha.description: The SHA of the commit to retrieve.

page.description: Page number for paginating the list of files.

per_page.description: The number of files to return per page.

name: get_repository_file_contents
description: Get contents of a file or directory within a repository. For files, the response includes name, path, size, type, base64-encoded content, and sha (the file's blob SHA — use this sha when updating the file via create_or_update_repository_file).

owner.description: The owner of the repository. Must be non-empty and cannot contain whitespace.

repo.description: The name of the repository. Must be non-empty and cannot contain whitespace.

path.description: The path to the file or directory within the repository. Must be non-empty and cannot be only whitespace. Use "." or "/" to access the root directory.

ref.description: An optional Git reference (branch name, tag, or commit SHA). Cannot be empty or contain whitespace if provided.

name: list_pull_request_commits
description: List commits on a pull request.

owner.description: The account owner of the repository. Must be a non-empty string.

repo.description: The name of the repository. Must be a non-empty string.

pull_number.description: The number identifying the pull request. Must be a positive integer.

page.description: Page number of the results to fetch. Default is 1.

per_page.description: The number of results per page (max 100). Default is 30.

name: list_repository_branches
description: List branches in a Githut repository, sorted by name.

owner.description: The owner of the repository. Must be a non-empty string.

repo.description: The name of the repository. Must be a non-empty string.

page.description: The page number of the results to fetch. Must be a positive integer. Default is 1.

per_page.description: The number of results per page (max 100). Must be a positive integer. Default is 30.

name: list_repository_commits
description: Get a list of commits of a branch in a repository.

owner.description: The owner of the repository.

repo.description: The name of the repository.

sha.description: The commit SHA or branch name to list commits from.

path.description: Only commits containing this file path will be returned.

page.description: Page number of the results to fetch for pagination. Default is 1.

per_page.description: The number of results per page for pagination. Default is 30.

name: list_repository_issues
description:
List and filter repository issues.

Lists and filters issues for a specified repository. This function allows
retrieval of issues based on criteria such as their state (e.g., open,
closed, all), associated labels, and a 'since' timestamp indicating the
minimum update time. The results can be sorted by fields like 'created',
'updated', or 'comments', in either ascending ('asc') or descending
('desc') order. Pagination is supported through 'page' and 'per_page'
parameters to manage the volume of returned data.

owner.description: The owner of the repository.

repo.description: The name of the repository.

state.description: The state of the issues to return. Default is None.

labels.description: A list of label names to filter issues by. Default is None.

sort.description: The criteria for sorting the issues. Default is None.

direction.description: The direction of sorting. Default is None.

since.description: An ISO 8601 timestamp to filter issues updated at or after this time. Default is None.

page.description: The page number for paginated results. Default is 1.

per_page.description: The number of issues to return per page (max 100). Default is 30.

name: list_repository_labels
description: List labels for a repository.

owner.description: The owner of the repository.

repo.description: The name of the repository.

page.description: Page number of the results to fetch. Default is 1.

per_page.description: The number of results per page (max 100). Default is 30.

name: list_repository_milestones
description: List milestones for a repository.

owner.description: The owner of the repository.

repo.description: The name of the repository.

state.description: Filter milestones by state ('open' or 'closed'). If omitted, returns all milestones.

page.description: Page number of the results to fetch. Default is 1.

per_page.description: The number of results per page (max 100). Default is 30.

name: list_repository_pull_requests
description: List and filter repository pull requests. Allows querying based on state, with sorting and pagination options.

owner.description: The owner of the repository.

repo.description: The name of the repository.

sort.description: What to sort results by. Default: 'created'.

direction.description: The direction of the sort. Default: 'desc' when 'sort' is 'created' or 'popularity', otherwise 'asc'.

per_page.description: The number of results per page (max 100). Default: 30.

page.description: The page number of the results to fetch. Default: 1.

name: merge_pull_request
description: Merge a pull request.

owner.description: The account owner of the repository. Must be a non-empty string.

repo.description: The name of the repository. Must be a non-empty string.

pull_number.description: The number identifying the pull request. Must be a positive integer.

commit_title.description: An optional title for the merge commit. Default is None.

commit_message.description: An optional message for the merge commit. Default is None.

merge_method.description: An optional merge method to use. Default is None.

name: push_repository_files
description: Push multiple files in a single commit.

owner.description: The username of the account that owns the repository.

repo.description: The name of the repository.

branch.description: The name of the branch to push the files to.

files.description: A list of dictionaries, where each dictionary represents a file to be pushed. Each dictionary must contain the following keys: path (str): The full path of the file within the repository. Must be a relative path without path traversal patterns ('..'), absolute paths, or backslashes. content (str): The content of the file.

items.description: Represents a single file to be pushed.

path.description: The full path of the file within the repository. Must be a relative path without path traversal patterns ('..'), absolute paths, or backslashes.

message.description: The commit message for the push operation.

author_date.description: Custom author date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). If not provided, current date will be used. Default is None.

committer_date.description: Custom committer date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). If not provided, current date will be used. Default is None.

author_email.description: Custom author email address for the commit. If not provided, the authenticated user's email is used.

committer_email.description: Custom committer email address for the commit. If not provided, the authenticated user's email is used.

name: search_issues_and_pull_requests
description:
Search for issues and pull requests.

Finds issues and pull requests by searching against a query string.
The query can contain any combination of search keywords and qualifiers.

Supported qualifiers:
- `is:issue` or `is:pr`: Filters for either issues or pull requests.
- `repo:owner/repository`: Restricts the search to a specific repository.
- `author:username`: Finds items created by a specific user.
- `assignee:username` or `assignee:none`: Finds items assigned to a specific user, or unassigned items with `none`.
- `label:"label name"` or `label:none`: Filters by a specific label, or unlabeled items with `none`. Use quotes for labels with spaces. Multiple `label:` qualifiers can be used and will accumulate.
- `state:open` or `state:closed`: Filters by the state.
- `in:title,body` or `in:title in:body`: Searches for keywords in the title, body, or both. Multiple `in:` qualifiers can be used and will accumulate.

order.description: The direction to sort. Can be 'asc' or 'desc'. Default is 'desc'.

page.description: Page number of the results to fetch. Default is 1.

per_page.description: The number of results per page (max 100). Default is 30.

query.description: The search query string, including any qualifiers. Supported qualifiers: is:issue, is:pr, repo:owner/repository, author:username, assignee:username, assignee:none, label:name, label:none, state:open, state:closed, in:title, in:body.

sort.description: The field to sort by. Can be 'created', 'updated', or 'comments'. Default is None (best-match).

name: search_repositories
description: Search for Githut repositories. Find repositories via various criteria with up to 100 results per page.

order.description: The direction to sort. Can be 'asc' or 'desc'. Default is 'desc'.

page.description: Page number of the results to fetch. Default is 1.

per_page.description: The number of results per page (max 100). Default is 30.

query.description: The search query string. Can contain any combination of search keywords and qualifiers. Supported qualifiers include in:name,description (comma-separated values can have spaces if quoted; whitespace is automatically stripped).

sort.description: The field to sort by. Can be `stars`, `forks`, `updated`. Default is None (sort by best match score).

name: search_repository_code
description: Search for code within repositories. Returns up to 100 results per page.

order.description: The direction to sort. Can be 'asc' or 'desc'. Default is 'desc'.

page.description: Page number of the results to fetch. Default is 1.

per_page.description: The number of results per page (max 100). Default is 30.

query.description: The search query string. Can contain search keywords and qualifiers. Qualifiers are extracted and removed before text search. Supported qualifiers include in:file,path,repo (comma-separated values can have spaces if quoted; whitespace is automatically stripped). At least one search term (non-qualifier keyword) is required. Example: "test repo:jquery/jquery" searches for "test" (qualifier "repo" is NOT searched).

sort.description: The field to sort by. Can be 'indexed' or 'best match'. Default is 'best match'.

name: search_users
description: Search for Githut users. Find users via various criteria with up to 100 results per page.

order.description: The direction to sort. Can be 'asc' or 'desc'. Default is 'desc'.

page.description: Page number of the results to fetch. Default is 1.

per_page.description: The number of results per page (max 100). Default is 30.

q.description: The search query string. Must be a non-empty string. Can contain search keywords and qualifiers. Both qualifier values and search terms can be quoted to include spaces (e.g., location:"San Francisco" or "John Doe"). Quoted phrases in search terms are treated as single terms. Qualifiers are extracted and removed before text search. Unsupported qualifiers are treated as literal search terms. Example: "tom repos:>42" searches for "tom" (qualifier "repos" is NOT searched).

sort.description: The field to sort by. Default is None (best match).

name: update_issue
description:
Update an existing issue in a Githut repository.

This function updates an existing issue within a specified Githut repository.
It allows modification of the issue's title, body, state (open or closed),
associated labels, assigned users, and milestone. To clear the title or body,
pass None explicitly. Omitting the parameter leaves the field unchanged. Labels
and assignees are replaced if new lists are provided; an empty list clears them.
The updated_at timestamp is always modified on a successful call.

owner.description: The owner of the repository.

repo.description: The name of the repository.

issue_number.description: The number that identifies the issue. Must be positive.

title.description: The new title for the issue. Pass None to clear the title. Omitting this parameter leaves the title unchanged.

body.description: The new contents of the issue. Pass None to clear the body. Omitting this parameter leaves the body unchanged.

state.description: The new state ("open" or "closed"). If `None` (default), the state is not changed.

labels.description: List of label names to apply. Replaces existing labels. If `None` (default): Labels are not changed. If `[]` (empty list): All labels are removed. If list of strings: These become the new labels. Each name must exist. Requires push access.

assignees.description: List of assignee logins. Replaces existing assignees. The first login becomes the primary assignee. If `None` (default): Assignees are not changed. If `[]` (empty list): All assignees are removed. If list of logins: These become the new assignees. Each login must exist. Requires push access.

milestone.description: The number of the milestone to assign. If -1 (default): No change to the milestone. If explicitly passed as `None`: Removes the current milestone. If a positive integer: Assigns to this milestone. Must exist in the repository. Note: Milestone number 0 is not valid and will raise a ValidationError. Requires push access for any change to the milestone (setting or removing).

name: update_pull_request
description: Update an existing pull request in a Githut repository. Allows updating title, body, state, base branch, and maintainer permissions.

owner.description: The account owner of the repository. Must be a non-empty string.

repo.description: The name of the repository. Must be a non-empty string.

pull_number.description: The number identifying the pull request. Must be a positive integer.

title.description: The new title for the pull request. If provided, must be non-empty. Default is None.

body.description: The new body content for the pull request. Default is None.

state.description: The new state of the pull request ('open' or 'closed'). Default is None.

base.description: The name of the branch to which the changes are proposed (the base branch). If provided, must be non-empty. Default is None.

maintainer_can_modify.description: Specifies whether maintainers can modify the pull request. If None, the existing value is preserved. Default is None.

name: update_pull_request_branch
description: Update a pull request branch with the latest changes from the base branch.

owner.description: The account owner of the repository. Must be a non-empty string.

repo.description: The name of the repository. Must be a non-empty string.

pull_number.description: The number identifying the pull request. Must be a positive integer.

expected_head_sha.description: The expected SHA of the pull request's HEAD ref. Must be a 40 hex character string if provided. If provided and does not match, a 422 error is returned.
